asset.name: Toilet — TOTO Aquia (dual flush)
asset.purchaseNote: tank manufacture date read from the stamp inside the tank; the building was completed in 2008

warranty.provider: TOTO (1-year limited on vitreous china; long expired)

asset.issue: Reported broken, Sep 2026. Handyman has asked for photos — they are on the Photos tab with a copy-paste summary. Before the visit, note the exact symptom here: won’t flush / keeps running / weak flush / leaking at the base / button stuck.
notes: Model identification: the tank exterior is printed “1.6 Gpf / 6.0 Lpf · 0.9 Gpf / 3.4 Lpf” — a dual flush. Of the three tanks on the parts label, only the Aquia (ID mark ST413M) is dual flush; both Drakes are 1.6 gpf single flush. ST413M is the tank of TOTO’s Aquia CST414M two-piece set (12″ rough-in, elongated, skirted, universal height, chrome push-button).
The bowl was not photographed. TOTO’s CST414M set pairs the ST413M tank with the CT414 bowl — confirm with the stamp on the bowl (underside / rear) when the handyman is here.
Colour code #01 = Cotton White (the “#01(W)” stamp). Order parts in #01 where colour matters (push button plate is chrome: #CP).
Tank label says DO NOT use chlorine-based disinfectants (drop-in tablets) in the tank — they degrade the flush valve seal.
Parts label revision 0EU047 REV 03/06; the fill valve in the photos is the older green-tinted assembly showing mineral scale — a likely culprit if the tank refills slowly or runs.
Where to look next: the ID mark is usually stamped into the porcelain on the inside rear wall of the tank; the bowl model is stamped on the bowl itself.

photos.cap: Whole unit — elongated, skirted (smooth-sided) bowl with a close-coupled tank. Seat and lid show staining; the seat is a separate part.
Tank exterior: “TOTO · 1.6 Gpf / 6.0 Lpf · 0.9 Gpf / 3.4 Lpf” — dual-flush rating that identifies the Aquia Dual-Max.
Parts label inside the tank lid/tank: Aquia row = ST413M · fill valve TSU09A.8 · flush valve THU224 · seal gasket 9BU064E · push button THU221#CP.
Same label, second angle (Drake rows are for other tanks — not this one).
Inside the tank: stamp “483 · 080421 · #01(W)” (Cotton White, made 2008-04-21) and the scaled fill-valve base.

asset.handymanSummary: Toilet: TOTO Aquia two-piece dual flush (1.6 / 0.9 gpf), model CST414M — tank ST413M, colour #01 Cotton White, tank date stamp 08/04/21. TOTO part numbers from the tank label: fill valve TSU09A.8, flush valve THU224, seal gasket 9BU064E, push button THU221#CP. Elongated skirted bowl, 12" rough-in. Address: 1803-8 Smithe Mews, Vancouver BC V6B 0A5, buzzer 6088.

schedule.howTo: Lift the lid, photograph the parts label, the fill valve (left tower), flush valve/seal (centre) and the push-button linkage. Compare with last year’s photos for scale build-up or a warped seal.

schedule.job: Dye test for silent tank leaks
schedule.howTo: Put a few drops of food colouring in the tank, wait 15 minutes without flushing. Colour in the bowl means the seal gasket (9BU064E) is leaking — replace it.
Unclip the seat, wash the hinge area, scrub under the rim with a brush and a non-chlorine cleaner. Never drop chlorine tablets in the tank.

schedule.job: Check tank-to-bowl bolts & base for seepage
schedule.howTo: Run a dry paper towel around the tank-to-bowl joint and around the base after a flush; any damp spot means a gasket or the wax ring needs attention.

parts.name: Elongated seat — TOTO SoftClose fits Aquia (confirm hinge spacing before ordering)

serviceLog.work: Toilet reported broken. Opened the tank, photographed the parts label, tank stamp and flush rating; identified the model as TOTO Aquia CST414M (tank ST413M). Photos sent to the handyman.
